name: Shelby Zhia
source:
[i]"We've just been looking the other way, waiting for someone else to step up and change this city."[/i]

[i]Twin who Weaves the Future[/i]

Hiyok's friend and a resident of Taozhe. The older twin to Zhiho, who cares deeply about her brother. Styling hair is her specialty, and she regularly cuts Zhiho's hair. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
